title: Service of subpoena.
bodyText: A subpoena issued by a clerk of court under section 624D-3 shall be served in compliance with rule 45(c) of the Hawaii rules of civil procedure.
bodyHtml: [§624D-4]  Service of subpoena.  A subpoena issued by a clerk of court under section 624D‑3 shall be served in compliance with rule 45(c) of the Hawaii rules of civil procedure. [L 2012, c 17, pt of §1]
